title: GEMglLogicOp
description: specify a logical pixel operation for color index rendering

messages.description: symbolic constant that selects a logical operation

arguments.description: symbolic constant that selects a logical operation

body: [GEMglLogicOp] calls glLogicOp() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. Its creation arguments also take GL constants by name; its inlets only take their values. See glLogicOp in the OpenGL reference.
